nl: Find people who studied at a university and belong to more than the threshold number of recently created forums, then count their one- or two-hop KNOWS contacts by browser among contacts of a given gender.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum) WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate WITH p, count(fo) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE f.gender = $gender RETURN f.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT p) AS qualifiedPersonCount

nl: Find people located in a named city that contains more than the threshold number of universities, then count their one- or two-hop KNOWS contacts using a selected browser by gender.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person) WHERE ci.name = $city WITH p, count(DISTINCT u) AS c WHERE c > 3 MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE f.browserUsed = $browser RETURN f.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT p) AS localPersonCount

nl: Find university alumni who created more than the threshold number of recent long posts, then count their older one- or two-hop KNOWS contacts by gender and browser.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND po.length > $minPostLength WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE f.birthday < $birthday RETURN f.gender AS gender, f.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT p) AS prolificAlumniCount

nl: Find university alumni with more than the threshold number of interests excluding a specified tag, then count their one- or two-hop KNOWS contacts from a selected IP by first name.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE t.name <> $excludedTag WITH p, count(DISTINCT t) AS c WHERE c > 3 MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE f.locationIP = $locationIP RETURN f.firstName AS firstName, count(DISTINCT p) AS interestedAlumniCount

nl: Rank countries by the number of non-excluded companies located there, then count matching-gender university students in their cities.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company) WHERE co.name <> $excludedCountry AND comp.name <> $excludedCompany WITH co, count(comp) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE p.gender = $gender AND u.name <> $excludedUniversity RETURN ci.name AS cityName, count(DISTINCT p) AS studentCount

nl: Rank countries by long post volume, then examine recent posts from those countries and count the authors' known people by author gender.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post) WHERE co.name <> $excludedCountry AND po.length > $minInitialLength WITH co, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p2:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE p2.creationDate > $postDate AND friend.browserUsed = $browser RETURN author.gender AS authorGender, count(DISTINCT friend) AS friendCount

nl: Rank countries by recent comment activity, then find long comments there that reply to posts and aggregate them by the post tag.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(cm:Comment) WHERE co.name <> $excludedCountry AND cm.creationDate > $commentDate WITH co, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(cmt:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE cmt.length > $minLength AND t.name <> $excludedTag RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT cmt) AS replyCommentCount

nl: Rank countries by the number of cities they contain, then find forums with qualifying members in those cities and count members per forum title.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City) WHERE co.name <> $excludedCountry AND ci.name <> $excludedCity WITH co, count(ci) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(person:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum) WHERE person.birthday > $birthday AND f.creationDate > $forumDate RETURN f.title AS forumTitle, count(DISTINCT person) AS memberCount
